about_the_game:
The Swordsman

The Swordsman is a fast-paced hack and slash game set in a 2.5D side-scrolling dark fantasy world. Take control of a skilled swordsman and battle against relentless waves of enemies. With its dynamic combat mechanics, strategic skill selection, and craftable gear system, every playthrough offers a fresh challenge

Fast-Paced and Fluid Combat

In The Swordsman, you can combine light and heavy attacks to execute deadly combos, utilizing various abilities to defeat enemies. The combat system is designed to test your reflexes and strategic thinking in intense battles.

Enemy waves become increasingly difficult, and at certain levels, you’ll face powerful boss fights that push your skills to the limit. Time your attacks wisely, dodge incoming strikes, and master the art of combat to survive.

Skill Progression Through Card Choices

Each time you level up, you’ll be presented with three random cards, each offering a new ability. If you choose the same card again in future selections, that skill levels up and becomes stronger.

Experiment with different combinations to adapt your ability and create devastating synergies to annihilate your foes.

Blacksmith and Equipment Crafting

As you battle through hordes of enemies, you’ll collect materials that can be used at the blacksmith to forge new swords, armor, and equipment. These upgrades will enhance your character’s abilities and help you progress further in each run.

Death is not the end! While your level resets upon dying, any collected equipment and crafted items remain, allowing you to become stronger with each attempt.

New Levels, New Enemies
